description: This file defines the TextNormalization class, which implements text normalization and slug generation functionality for Markdown content within a specific project. It includes configuration handling, text normalization, and slug truncation.

classes.name: TextNormalization
classes.description: A class responsible for normalizing text by generating URL-friendly slugs, with configurable maximum length, for Markdown content.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the maximum length for slug normalization based on configuration.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a given string into a slug, applying prefix, normalization, and length trimming.
